manifests.description: Laboratory information management: orders, samples, analyzers, quality control, results, and clinical review.
Pharmacy inventory, dispensing, clinical verification, and prescription fulfillment.
Radiology workflow, PACS, imaging studies, AI-assisted reads, and modality integration.
Hospital operations: encounters, admissions, departments, beds, nursing, and care continuum.
Blood donation, component processing, compatibility, and transfusion safety.
Population surveillance, notifiable diseases, immunization, and epidemic response.
Health insurance eligibility, claims, pricing, pre-authorization, and fraud detection.
Emergency medical services, triage, and critical care response.
Clinical research, data science, biobank, and evidence generation.
Citizen self-service: appointments, certificates, results, and personal health records (read-only over operational Domains).
Provider workspace for professionals to operate across the Domains they are privileged in (no domain administration).

shared_core.description: NIAM identity registry (person, enterprise, machine, guest).
Authentication (password, passkeys, OTP, OAuth2, OIDC, smart cards).
Immutable, hash-chained audit log for every platform event.
Push, email, SMS, in-app notification delivery.
Workflow engine for multi-step clinical and operational flows.
Unified search engine over platform records.
Report generation framework (domain reports build on it).
File storage and retrieval (MinIO / object storage).
Recurring job scheduling (domain workflows consume it).
FHIR R4 engine (resources, profiles, mappers, validation).
Event bus for async cross-domain events.
